_README: DPD Plugin 0.5.10 for Designer r31+. Install in project/Plugins/DPD-0.5.10. Connection and transports are detected automatically. No JSON edits are required.

designer._help_host: Legacy default. Native setup uses the Designer-supplied director parameter or the HTTP page address; no IP editing is required.
designer._help_port: Designer HTTP API port from d3Manager > Machine Settings > Advanced Network Configuration. Default is 80; value 0 disables the API.
designer._help_discovery: When true, the plugin asks the supplied session endpoint who the Director is and reconnects to it.
designer._help_override: Legacy compatibility setting; native automatic setup takes its endpoint from Designer, not this override.

main._help_transport: Legacy/demo preset. Live plugin setup discovers transports and asks for the main transport when needed.
main._help_expression: Legacy preset. Automatic live discovery replaces this expression with the selected transport.
main._help_priority: Optional exact layer names, highest priority first. Listed layers become the top rows/countdown source.

aux._help_transport: Legacy/demo preset. Live plugin setup selects the other discovered transport, or disables this role when only one exists.
aux._help_expression: Legacy preset. Automatic live discovery replaces this expression with the selected transport.

updates._help: Live Update subscription intervals in milliseconds, identical to standalone 0.4.13.
updates._help_outputs: LocalState.directorState().output is subscribed independently from transport and media timing. 0=FADE DOWN, 1=FADE UP, 2=HOLD.
updates._help_fps: Actual FPS on the connected Director via MonitoringManager. fps_average_samples=60 requests Designer's average of its latest 60 measurements, not 60 browser polls. Raw Actual/1 is logged and shown only in diagnostics. fps_ms=1000 controls subscription frequency. No cap at 60 FPS.
updates._help_media_metadata: Optional independent stream for Simple Next Duration. Reads VideoClip.transportDuration as Designer timecode, matched to the scheduled clip by resource UID. Unknown durations stay blank; section length is never used instead.
updates._help_audio: Independent read-only VideoClip.hasAudio metadata for Active/Previous/Next. The icon reports an embedded track, not audible output or file volume.
updates._help_preview_brightness: Reads the saved brightness sequence at the mapped media entry beat, before activation. Expression/Sockpuppet/external control stays unknown. Active brightness still uses the existing runtime subscription.
updates._help_future_layers: layers_ms controls the read-only catalogue of all graphical leaves of each selected track. Next compares future layer and media entry beats chronologically; this catalogue never creates Active rows.

logic._help_brightness: Compatibility threshold used only when an adapter supplies brightness; this build uses TrackPlayer.activeLayers for current graphical layers.
logic._help_labels: Default shows only SECTION NN. Optional sources: note, cue, index, number. Add them in the desired priority only if you intentionally want annotation text.
logic._help_section_metadata: Read TC, MIDI, CUE (shown as OSC), and notes at Current/Next Section breaks. Refresh runs independently from the timing WebSocket.

ui._help_project_name: Normally leave empty: the dashboard reads the project name from /api/session/status/project. Set text here only to override it.
ui._help_countdown_smoothing: Normally leave these values unchanged. Identical API samples no longer restart the timer; small higher samples are rejected as jitter, while a large difference or transport seek resynchronises immediately.
ui._help_live_threshold: A remaining duration at or above this value is treated as an open-ended/live source.
ui._help_audio_indicator: Approved placement: media-suffix (speaker at the right edge inside Media, filename ellipsis before it). Other options: media-prefix, layer-meta, media-label, off. Applies to all rows on both pages; only hasAudio=true shows the icon.
ui._help_next_active_animation: Entry AND exit of every displayed ACTIVE layer: off, fade, lift, accent, transfer. D has both previews and engine/counter diagnostics. Preference is shared by both views in this browser. Reduce motion disables effects unless explicitly allowed in D. No playback control.
